officialAnswerCellReview.cellMethod: OpenCV grid line segmentation of each official scanned final-answer PDF A/B page (6 subject tables per page, 25 answer cells per table). Five digit shapes were read from 2020 A Q1-Q5: 2,4,5,3,1; unlabeled-image centroid clustering was applied independently of staged candidate answer labels. Source comparison keyed by year+form+subject+questionNo; 596 single-number cells match staged candidates. This automatic image-template match is not per-cell independent human visual signoff.
officialAnswerCellReview.warning: A/B and elective economics/management group order in the official table must be distinguished; groups 5/6 correspond to economics first, management second. A mismatch count from question-number-only joins is invalid.
